purpose: Measure whether PPO learns conflict avoidance with fixed static route guidance and no action filter.
hypothesis: Separating obstacle routing from learned traffic avoidance makes the safety learning problem easier without attributing the route prior to RL.
initial_reference: Verify exact full policy tensor identity with the registered g1-f0 support control before reusing its evaluation.
comparisons: Exact own initial policy under the same support flags
Previous guidance-off PPO at the same approximate live budget; source logging parity documented.
limitations: One exploratory training seed, not independent replication across seeds.
A 100k pilot tests direction and execution, not convergence or competition readiness.
Route guidance is classical support; only trained-minus-initial differences count as learning.
Three training seeds, separately trained support configurations and unseen evaluation remain required.
